player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} ({piece}). Kaibaan ed ({opp}).
Isumitey so mga makakalibe a '[a2 a3]' (manlapud → ed to).
- Say normal a makakalibe so saray masanton a step ed saray adjacent a baley a vertex.
- Say capture so saray jump ed saray adjacent a kaibaan a pieza a lumbe' ed saray baley a node a dumadalen.
Say anggad capture so ag {score_per_capture} a puntos.
Say juego so natapos ed siam {max_moves} a makakalibe o no diad say saray player so wala'y legal a makakalibe.

invalid_move.bad_format: Mauges ya format. Usaren so "[a2 a3]".
invalid_move.not_your_piece: Aliwan sika so manunan akauley ed satan.
invalid_move.dest_not_empty: Say destinasyon to et aliwan anggapoy karga.

game_action.captured: Say Player {player_id} so inaro ang saray pieza! (+{score_per_capture})

outcome.higher_score: Mas atagey so score na saray akapatey.
